senses.gloss:
मि(डुञ्)डुमिञ् r. 5th cl. (मिनोति मिनुते)
 1. To cast, to throw, to throw
about, to scatter.
 2. To measure.
 3. To perceive. (This root is not
used in classics.)

मी r. 1st and 10th cls. (मयति माययति-ते)
 1. To go, to move.
 2. To
know. (टु, ङ्) टुमीङ् r.
 4. cl. (मीयते) To part with life, to die. (ञ)
मीञ् r. 9th cl. (मीनाति मीनीते)
 1. To hurt, to injure, to kill.
 2. To
violate.
 3. To diminish.
 4. To go astray.
